verdict.rationale: JumpCloud claims a dedicated HRIS integration for onboarding new employees and removing departed ones with minimal manual work. It also documents importing users from an HR system as the authoritative source and automating identity creation, access changes and termination across the lifecycle. All of this comes from marketing-level pages with no depth on how the flows work. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of mover handling (attribute or department changes driving group and app reassignment), detail on downstream SCIM provisioning to app assignments, a list of supported HRIS connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
